proposal_source: Exact small-space gradients before evaluation; fixed steps. Never tune proposals using evaluation samples.
interval_rule: Two-sided Hoeffding union bound for current plus all four fixed proposals, risk and normalized cost each in [0,1]. Separate SHA case IDs give distinct main and pilot RNG streams. Require per-family risk UCB within predeclared cap and candidate macro normalized cost UCB strictly below current LCB.
